lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# `bundled` compiles SQLite from source (matches src-tauri) for cross-platform reliability.
# Runtime connector presets store (#1235): the deprecated `bsc-plan integration` verb (#1721) still
# reads/writes the same RuntimePreset shape `bsc-data connector` now owns. `default-features = false` keeps the heavy
# DuckDB store out of the CLI — the preset/connector logic compiles without it.
# Shared SQLite CLI+lib helpers (#1621): JSON value-list (de)serialization + the stdin/print
# helpers the `bsc-plan` CLI shares with `bsc-skill` / `bsc-logs`. `conn` adds the open + busy_timeout
# connection plumbing the store shares with skilldb/compliance/research (#1863).
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `cli_main` (the `main` wrapper) + `resolve_store_path` (--db→env→default).
# Shared leaf helpers (#1646): the ONE civil-date formatter, so the coord timestamp cannot drift
# from the `bsc-*` shell emitters that write the same log (#4021) — AND the canonical model-tier
# registry the classification's `model` axis names in its refusal.
# `classify set` checks its `model` axis against what can actually be launched — THE ONE RULE lives in
# `llm::cli::verify_model`, beside the blocking probe it needs, shared with `bsc persona model` and
# `bsc teams model` so the levels of the precedence chain cannot drift (`discovery-chooses-the-model`).
# `fleet skills` checks each planned skill id against the skills library before storing it, so a typo is
# refused rather than launching a fleet session with nothing (a-skill-reaches-only-the-profiles-it-names).
# The lane engine (`the-committed-record-stores-write-into-lanes`): `bsc plan integrate` lands an incoming
# branch's lane into the committed record stores instead of leaving a binary merge for a person.
# The machine document stores (`integrate-lands-every-laned-store`): `bsc plan integrate` lands an incoming
# branch's lane in every migrated document store, found by the same discovery `bsc studio migrate` walks.
